AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-22-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of two minors
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S.Ravinantapricha, CSR: Margaret Ashwell.
Petitioner: Koon Ying Wong Chow, present in pro per with the minors: Chun Ting Chow and Chun Hei Chow, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Charles Zhang, was sworn and examined.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for change of the MINOR'S name from Chun Ting Chow to: Clarence Chunting Chow and from Chun Hei Chow to: Jason Chunhei Chow.
Decrees signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-25-2004 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day for name change.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: Marta Vallejo, CSR: Sara Lerschen
Petitioner: Koon Ying Wong Chow, present in pro-per with Cantonese interpreter: Charles Zhau
No proof of publication has been filed, Petitioner to file an amended petition and get a new date. The matter is taken off calendar.
